scope: Three-node stationary Z1, cap one, 1000 ms schedule, B1 and B2
forecast: Use the original changing-traffic two-second forecast without fitting to this seed
point_budget: Use the midpoint of the two predicted demands for each matched node/window
uncertainty: Use the existing min/max error envelopes from the historical stationary cap-one calibration seed 223457, inclusive of zero. Select only if exactly one action has an upper bound within budget and the other has a lower bound above budget
acceptance: Count point-budget agreement, observed relative ranking, and conservative correct, wrong or abstained windows separately. All-abstention cannot establish residual-aware ranking
pairing: Same topology, target, power-model, schedule, seed, and substantive source hashes. Pair same-node ordinal windows anchored to each run's first GEN event
role_of_prior_seed: Seed 123456 was used to diagnose the failure and is not the new holdout
